name: Deepak Nitrite Limited
summary: Deepak Nitrite Limited manufactures, trades, and sells chemical intermediates in India and internationally. It operates through Advanced Intermediates and Phenolics segments. The company offers sodium nitrite, sodium nitrate, nitro toluidines, fuel additives, nitrosylsulfuric acid, xylidines, oximes, cumidines, speciality agrochemicals, optical brighteners, nitric acid, fluorinated compounds, DASDA, benzotrifluoride, cumene, phenol, acetone, isopropyl alcohol, and alpha methyl styrene. It also provides 2 MePPDA, 2,3-xylidine, 2,4-xylidine, 2,6-xylidine, 2-ethylhexyl nitrate, 3-NOX, 4-NOX; 2B, 4BBT, ABP, ABP X, and BMK deepwhite powders; 2BL, ABP, AS, BA, BHT HC, DSP, MST, SPF Z, SI, UBR, UP,…
